By Joshua Wilburn,

U.S. Ambassador to IsraelMike Huckabee said Israeli intelligence recently uncovered what he described as “a very specific plot” aimed at assassinating President Donald Trump, revealing that the information was immediately shared with U.S. officials.

Speaking in an interview with Fox News, Huckabee said Israeli intelligence had alerted Washington to the alleged threat.

“Israeli intelligence tipped off our side, the president and our officials that there was a very specific plot that was designed to take out President Trump,” said Huckabee.

Huckabee declined to discuss whether the intelligence warning influenced Trump’s reported decision to leave Turkey aboard a former presidential aircraft instead of a newer plane recently offered by Qatar.

“I can only speak about what’s in the public reports and that is that there was a plot and Israeli intelligence picked it up and shared it with the United States. That is all I can add,” he said.

The reported intelligence warning has drawn scrutiny following a Wall Street Journal report that said some U.S. officials questioned the credibility of the threat. According to the outlet, those officials believed Israel may have shared the intelligence in an effort to persuade Washington to resume open military action against Iran. The report also said some officials believed Israel presented a single piece of intelligence that, viewed in isolation, could encourage Trump to authorize renewed strikes against Iran.

Israel’s embassy to the United States rejected that suggestion, saying the intelligence was shared as part of the close security partnership between the two countries and not for any ulterior motive.

Trump also disputed part of the reporting during a phone interview with the New York Post.

“No, no. Israel didn’t discover anything. I’ve been at the top of Iran’s blacklist for a long time,” he told reporters on Air Force One.

Huckabee also argued that Iran’s posture toward the United States has remained unchanged for decades.

“What the Iranians are saying and doing is nothing that they haven’t been doing for 47 years,” Huckabee explained. “This is a longstanding ‘death to America’ chant they’ve had. They really haven’t changed.”

Trump later responded to the reported assassination threats on Truth Social, writing, “1,000 missiles are locked and loaded.”

“Orders have already been given and the US Military is ready, willing and able, for a one-year period of time, subject to extension, to completely decimate and destroy all areas of Iran,” Trump warned.

In a separate interview with the New York Post, Trump added, “I’ve left instructions, if anything happens, to just literally bomb them at levels that they’ve never seen before.”

Trump’s polling numbers hit a new low. Don’t expect him to change course.

Russia has about 143 million. Even using the higher Ukrainian estimate, that’s a population edge of close to four to one before a single shot is fired, a bottomless well of conscripts, mechanics, drivers, factory hands, and mothers who will bury their sons and keep sending more, because the Putin’s state machine keeps running regardless.
